goal: Talk about your work experience, or an internship or project if you have not had a job yet.

phrases.text: I have ... years of experience in ...

meaning.roman: Mujhe ... mein ... saal ka tajurba hai.

phrases.example: I have two years of experience in customer support.

meaning.roman: Maine ... mein ... ke taur par kaam kiya.

phrases.example: I worked as a sales assistant at a shop in Karachi.
I did an internship at a small marketing office.

meaning.roman: Meri sab se bari zimmedari ... thi.

phrases.example: My main responsibility was answering customer questions.

roleplay.tutor_line: Tell me about your work experience.

task.roman: Apne tajurbe ke baare mein batayein: kitne saal aur kis kaam mein.

roleplay.model_answer: I have two years of experience in customer support. I worked as a support assistant at a small company in Karachi.

roleplay.tutor_line: What was your main responsibility in that job?

task.roman: Batayein ke aap ki sab se bari zimmedari kya thi.

roleplay.model_answer: My main responsibility was answering customer questions and solving their problems. I also kept a record of every call.

roleplay.tutor_line: I see you have just finished your degree. Have you done any internship or project work?

task.roman: Agar aap ne internship ya project kiya hai to uske baare mein batayein.

roleplay.model_answer: Yes, I did an internship at a small marketing office for three months. I helped the team prepare simple reports.

roleplay.tutor_line: What did you enjoy most about that work?

task.roman: Batayein ke aap ko us kaam mein sab se zyada kya pasand aaya.

roleplay.model_answer: I enjoyed helping people. When a customer thanked me, I felt happy and proud of my work.

roleplay.tutor_line: Why is this experience useful for this job?

task.roman: Batayein ke aap ka tajurba is kaam ke liye kaise faidemand hai.

roleplay.model_answer: I have two years of experience in customer support, so I know how to speak politely and stay calm with customers.

review_notes: Turn 3 is for learners with no job experience (internship or project). Is that enough, or should the lesson have a longer path for complete beginners?
